Messages.Body:
What happens if Marie Faucigny plays an equipment with cost 0? Does she
gain 1 blood/her methuselah gain 1 pool? (My guess is obviously NO, but
anyway.) If not - why not? Thanks.

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:


No.
There's no such thing as a "negative cost".

Messages.Author: firstco...@aol.com
Messages.Body:


She has to pay 0 blood/pool, and here's why:

All quantities in vampire can be negative:
Negative strength
Negative bleed
Negative votes
Negative pool
Negative intercept
Negative stealth
etc.

However, when the number has to actually do something, if it's less
than 0, then its total effect is 0.

Like, if you swing with -2 strength, you do 0 damage.
If you bleed for -1, they lose 0 pool.
If you have negative votes, you cast 0 votes.

The only times it matters that you're negative is if you want to:
1) Count the total involved
2) Increase your value above 0 (Disarm interacts with Undead Strength
to hit for 1)

You can count total intercept or stealth when comparing one to the
other, for example, so -1 intercept does matter. Or, you could give a
vampire with -1 votes a -1 strength "bonus" from Island of Yiaros.

So your equipment really does cost -1 pool, and that means it functions
as cost 0 when you equip it, unless something increases the cost.

Understand?

-- Brian
P.S. There are some stated exceptions in the rules to everything going
negative, such as vampires are unable to have capacity <1, but that too
may be an endpoint limit. LSJ -- if a vampire has 1 capacity, and gets
-2 capacity, he still needs 3 skill cards to be a 2 cap, right?

Messages.Author: d
Messages.Body:
I don't think so for Capacity, because most (all?) card effects that
reduce Capacity specifically say it cannot be reduced below 1. So I
don't think any further capacity reduction effects 'linger' to be
counted against future Skill Cards.
